item.title: Neutralizing Orbital Decay: Airbus Deploys Passive Damping to Secure LEO
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
With 36,500+ tracked debris objects threatening Low Earth Orbit, Airbus reaches TRL 8 on its 200g Detumbler. Passive magnetic damping neutralizes satellite tumbling without electrical power, enabling active debris removal at scale.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Utilizes permanent magnet rotors to generate eddy current braking proportional to B rather than B², exponentially accelerating energy dissipation. [SPLIT] ⚡ Meets European Space Agency Zero Debris requirements by reducing spin rates from 3°/s to 0.75°/s within a single year for platforms up to 1.5 tons. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/neutralizing-orbital-decay-airbus-deploys-passive-damping-to-secure-leo-879872.html
